title: Retrieval Supersedes Scale: Efficient Log Level Prediction via Multiplex Socio-Technical Context
title_zh: 检索胜过规模：基于多路社会技术上下文的高效日志级别预测

paragraphs.en: 基于功能和所有权的社会技术检索优于随机采样，使LLM日志级别预测AUC最高达0.97。 Developers insert logging statements in source code to record its execution, and the resulting logs are essential for detecting and troubleshooting system anomalies. A key part of these statements is the log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), which determines whether a message is recorded. Choosing it is a trade-off: levels set too low mask important information in production, while levels set too high create noisy logs and extra I/O and storage overhead. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) with In-Context Learning (ICL) to predict log levels, but typically augments the prompt with randomly sampled examples. We argue that this overlooks the socio-technical nature of logging, where conventions vary by component and development team. Off-the-shelf LLMs using random examples are reported to achieve median AUCs of only 0.56 to 0.76, leaving room for improvement without fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose a retrieval approach for LLM-powered log level prediction that prioritizes context relevance over random selection and basic similarity. Our method retrieves logging examples relevant along two socio-technical dimensions: (i) functionality (code performing similar operations) and (ii) ownership (code maintained by the same developers). Evaluating four LLMs across ten popular Java projects, we find that this retrieval improves AUC over random baselines by 0.07 (median), and combining both signals yields median AUCs of 0.83 to 0.97. Our ablation studies show that each signal improves on random retrieval, and that combining them outperforms the stronger of the two on all ten projects. Our results also significantly exceed state-of-the-art supervised predictors (e.g., DeepLV) by a median AUC of 0.12 to 0.19. Our findings highlight the importance of socio-technical signals such as code functionality and ownership for LLM-powered log level prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 基于功能和所有权的社会技术检索优于随机采样，使LLM日志级别预测AUC最高达0.97。开发人员在源代码中插入日志语句以记录代码的执行情况，由此产生的日志对于检测和排查系统异常至关重要。 这些语句的一个关键部分是日志级别（如DEBUG、INFO、WARN、ERROR），它决定了消息是否会被记录下来。 选择日志级别是一种权衡：级别设置得过低会在生产环境中掩盖重要信息，而设置得过高则会产生嘈杂的日志以及额外的I/O和存储开销。 近期的工作使用大语言模型（LLM）结合上下文学习（ICL）来预测日志级别，但通常使用随机采样的示例来增强提示。 我们认为，这忽视了日志编写的社会技术属性，即其惯例因组件和开发团队而异。 据报道，使用随机示例的现成LLM仅能取得0.56至0.76的中位数AUC，这表明在不进行微调的情况下仍有改进空间。 在本文中，我们提出了一种面向LLM日志级别预测的检索方法，它优先考虑上下文相关性，而非随机选择和基本相似度。 我们的方法沿两个社会技术维度检索相关的日志编写示例：(i) 功能性（执行相似操作的代码）和(ii) 所有权（由相同开发人员维护的代码）。 通过在十个流行的Java项目上评估四个LLM，我们发现这种检索方法相比随机基线将AUC提升了0.07（中位数），而结合两种信号可取得0.83至0.97的中位数AUC。 我们的消融实验表明，每种信号都优于随机检索，且在全部十个项目上，将两者结合的表现均优于其中更强的单一信号。 我们的结果还显著超越了最先进的监督式预测器（如DeepLV），中位数AUC领先0.12至0.19。 我们的研究结果凸显了代码功能和所有权等社会技术信号对于LLM日志级别预测的重要性。
